welcome.reply: Just tell me what you need. I can research, compare flights, or complete steps on the web—the live browser on the right shows what I am doing.
examples: Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore and summarize the key facts about the country.
Look up today's weather in Shanghai and tell me in one sentence whether I need an umbrella.
Open Hacker News and tell me the #1 post title and what people are discussing.

browser.emptyLine2: For login or CAPTCHA, you can interact directly in the view.
